notes:
## New features
- None in this release.

## Changes
- Faster screened-path calculations: avoid searching for lateral paths when an endpoint has no possible connection, and reuse immutable building geometry. A matched 32-receiver P2001 check ran about 1.9 times faster with identical levels. Full-scene Calculate timings have not been verified; dense scenes can still take minutes.
- Changing contour detail reuses the prepared scalar field and domain. Calculation settings, source resolution, reflection settings and numerical tolerances are unchanged.

## Bug fixes
- SmartSmooth now honours Raw, 2×, 4×, 8× and 16× detail throughout the calculation and presentation routes instead of forcing some requests to 16×.
- Reject reuse of a contour field when its raw values or additional acoustic support have changed.
- Existing support-limit warnings remain visible: reaching the calculation-point limit does not establish interpolation convergence.
- macOS application is ad-hoc signed, not Apple notarized. Focused hotfix verification is not a new full-suite or ISO conformance claim.
